units.source_text: 不久，1947年春上，我进了大谷大学的预科。

en.t: Before long, in the spring of 1947, I entered the preparatory course at Otani University.

units.source_text: 这时，表面上我似乎是在老师不渝的宠爱和同事的羡慕之下意气风发地入学的，其实并非如此。

en.t: At that time, on the surface, I seemed to have entered school in high spirits, under my teacher's unwavering favor and the envy of my fellow students, but in truth that was not the case.

units.source_text: 关于这欢升学，有件事情回想起来也觉可根。

en.t: As for this supposedly happy advancement to a higher school, there was one matter that, even when I think back on it, still seems hateful.
